    -- Lua numerals are unsigned: a minus key is the unary operator applied to
    -- the numeral's value, so key naming negates the value exactly as checking
    -- does — parsing "-0x2" as one text instead would strand every signed radix
    -- spelling on a NaN key, which no Lua table can hold. The hex spelling
    -- routes augmentation to the same arm as its decimal twin, and a
